description: This file provides utility functions for currency and credit conversions, formatting USD and credits amounts, parsing USD strings, and rendering formatted currency information as React components. It centralizes conversion rates and ensures consistent display of currency data across the application.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Convert a USD amount to credits based on the shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parse a USD-like value from various input formats into a numeric value; returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Format a number of credits with thousands separators and a 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Format a numeric value as USD currency string using a shared formatter.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Format a USD value with credits included in the string, e.g., '$X (Y credits)'.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Render USD with associated credits in a React span, showing formatted USD and credits with a tooltip.

methods.name: renderCreditsWithUsd
methods.description: Alias for renderUsdWithCredits, maintaining backward compatibility.
